name: Response Evaluators
description: Pluggable evaluator implementations behind a runtime-checkable Evaluator Protocol. Each evaluator takes a local TaskResponse and a remote TaskResponse (ground truth) plus task-specific EvaluatorConfig, and returns an EvaluationResult (score 0.0–1.0, per-field breakdown, evaluator type used, arbitrary metadata). Implementations: StructuredMatchEvaluator (per-field exact match rate averaged across configured match_fields), ExactMatchEvaluator (full output string equality, binary 0.0 or 1.0), SemanticSimilarityEvaluator (cosine similarity of sentence embeddings, lazy-loads sentence-transformers model, caches by model name, configurable model_name). Custom evaluator support via Python dotted import path resolved at startup. All evaluators are stateless, independently testable, and require no inheritance — only Protocol conformance. The evaluator registry is a plain dict[str, Evaluator] built in the composition root with no global state.

types.name: TaskResponse

fields.name: output
fields.description: The full textual output of the task response.

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Structured key-value field breakdown of the response. Keys are field names, values are string representations. Empty dict for unstructured responses.

types.description: Represents a single task response (local or remote). Imported from config_and_registry at runtime but defined here for contract completeness. Frozen Pydantic v2 model.

types.name: EvaluationResult

fields.name: score
fields.description: Overall evaluation score. 0.0 = no match, 1.0 = perfect match.

validators.error_message: score must be between 0.0 and 1.0 inclusive

fields.name: field_scores
fields.description: Per-field score breakdown. Keys are field names, values are float scores in [0.0, 1.0]. Empty dict for non-structured evaluators (ExactMatch, SemanticSimilarity).

fields.name: evaluator_type
fields.description: Identifier of the evaluator that produced this result. One of: 'structured_match', 'exact_match', 'semantic_similarity', or a custom evaluator identifier.

validators.error_message: evaluator_type must be a non-empty string

fields.name: metadata
fields.description: Arbitrary metadata about the evaluation. Values restricted to str, int, float, bool, or None. Used for diagnostics, auditing, and debugging.

types.description: Frozen Pydantic v2 model representing the outcome of a single evaluation. Immutable after construction.

types.name: EvaluatorConfigType
types.description: Discriminator values for the EvaluatorConfig union. Determines which evaluator implementation is used.

types.name: StructuredMatchConfig

fields.name: match_fields
fields.description: List of field names to compare between local and remote responses. Each field is compared via exact string equality. Score is the average match rate across all listed fields.

validators.error_message: match_fields must contain at least one field name

types.description: Configuration for StructuredMatchEvaluator. Specifies which fields to compare via exact equality.

types.name: ExactMatchConfig
types.description: Configuration for ExactMatchEvaluator. No additional parameters needed.

types.name: SemanticSimilarityConfig

fields.name: model_name
fields.description: Name or path of the sentence-transformers model used for encoding. Loaded lazily on first evaluation. Cached by name in a module-level dict.

validators.error_message: model_name must be a non-empty string

types.description: Configuration for SemanticSimilarityEvaluator. Specifies the sentence-transformers model to use for embedding generation.

types.name: CustomEvaluatorConfig

fields.name: import_path
fields.description: Python dotted path to the custom evaluator class or function. Example: 'mypackage.evaluators.my_evaluator'. Resolved at startup via importlib.

validators.error_message: import_path must be a valid Python dotted path with at least two segments

fields.name: params
fields.description: Optional keyword arguments passed to the custom evaluator constructor (if class) or ignored (if bare function). Keys are strings, values are any JSON-serializable type.

types.description: Configuration for loading a custom evaluator via a Python dotted import path. The import_path must point to either a class satisfying the Evaluator protocol or a bare callable with the evaluate signature, which will be wrapped.

types.name: EvaluatorConfig
types.description: Pydantic discriminated union over evaluator configurations. Discriminated on the 'type' field. Exactly one subtype is active per config instance.

types.name: EvaluatorRegistry

fields.name: evaluators
fields.description: Mapping from evaluator type string (e.g. 'structured_match', 'exact_match', 'semantic_similarity', or custom name) to an object satisfying the Evaluator protocol.

types.description: A plain mapping from evaluator type name to an evaluator instance. Built in the composition root at startup. Not a singleton — passed explicitly via dependency injection.

functions.name: evaluate
functions.description: Core protocol method. Compares a local TaskResponse against a remote TaskResponse (ground truth) using the evaluator's strategy and the provided config. Returns an EvaluationResult with a score in [0.0, 1.0]. This is the single method defined by the @runtime_checkable Evaluator Protocol. All evaluator implementations must satisfy this signature.

inputs.name: local
inputs.description: The response produced by the local (fine-tuned) model. The candidate being evaluated.

inputs.name: remote
inputs.description: The response produced by the remote (ground truth) model. The reference standard for comparison.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Evaluator-specific configuration. The concrete subtype must match the evaluator implementation being invoked.

structured_side_effects.description: Evaluators are stateless and produce no side effects. SemanticSimilarityEvaluator may lazy-load and cache a model on first call but this is idempotent.

functions.name: resolve_custom_evaluator
functions.description: Resolves a custom evaluator from a Python dotted import path. Imports the object via importlib, validates it against the @runtime_checkable Evaluator Protocol, and wraps bare callables into a Protocol-conforming wrapper. Called at startup during composition root wiring. Fails fast if the path is unresolvable or the object does not satisfy the protocol.

inputs.name: import_path
inputs.description: Python dotted path to a class or callable. Must have at least two segments (e.g. 'pkg.module.name').

inputs.name: params
inputs.description: Optional keyword arguments to pass to the constructor if the resolved object is a class. Ignored if the resolved object is a bare function.

error_data.detail: Could not resolve import_path: module or attribute not found

error_cases.name: object_not_protocol_conformant
error_cases.condition: The resolved object is neither a class with an evaluate method nor a callable with the correct signature

error_data.detail: Resolved object does not satisfy the Evaluator protocol and cannot be wrapped as a callable

error_cases.name: constructor_params_invalid
error_cases.condition: The resolved class constructor rejects the provided params

error_data.detail: Custom evaluator class constructor rejected the provided params

preconditions: import_path is a valid Python dotted path with at least two segments
The module referenced by import_path is importable in the current Python environment
The resolved object is either a class satisfying the Evaluator protocol or a callable with signature (TaskResponse, TaskResponse, EvaluatorConfig) -> EvaluationResult
postconditions: Returned object satisfies the @runtime_checkable Evaluator Protocol
If the resolved object was a bare callable, it is wrapped in a Protocol-conforming adapter
If the resolved object was a class, it is instantiated with the provided params

structured_side_effects.description: Pure import and validation logic. No persistent side effects.

functions.name: build_evaluator_registry
functions.description: Builds the evaluator registry dict from a list of EvaluatorConfig entries. Instantiates each built-in evaluator and resolves each custom evaluator via resolve_custom_evaluator. Returns a plain dict[str, Evaluator] mapping evaluator type names to instances. Called once at startup in the composition root. Fails fast on any resolution error.

inputs.name: configs
inputs.description: List of EvaluatorConfig instances (the union type) to register. Each config's type discriminator becomes the registry key.

preconditions: configs is a non-empty list of valid EvaluatorConfig instances

structured_side_effects.description: Registry construction is pure instantiation logic with no persistent side effects.

functions.name: structured_match_evaluate
functions.description: StructuredMatchEvaluator implementation of the evaluate protocol method. Compares each field in config.match_fields between local.fields and remote.fields via exact string equality. Returns the arithmetic mean of per-field scores (1.0 for match, 0.0 for mismatch). Populates field_scores with individual field results.

inputs.name: local
inputs.description: The local model's response containing structured fields.

inputs.name: remote
inputs.description: The remote (ground truth) model's response containing structured fields.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Configuration specifying which fields to compare.

error_cases.condition: A match_field is not present in local.fields

error_data.detail: match_field not found in local TaskResponse fields

error_cases.name: missing_field_in_remote
error_cases.condition: A match_field is not present in remote.fields

error_data.detail: match_field not found in remote TaskResponse fields

preconditions: config.type == 'structured_match'
config.match_fields is non-empty
All field names in config.match_fields exist in both local.fields and remote.fields
postconditions: result.evaluator_type == 'structured_match'
result.field_scores has exactly len(config.match_fields) entries
Each value in result.field_scores is exactly 0.0 or 1.0
result.score == sum(result.field_scores.values()) / len(result.field_scores)
result.score is in [0.0, 1.0]

functions.name: exact_match_evaluate
functions.description: ExactMatchEvaluator implementation of the evaluate protocol method. Performs exact string equality comparison of local.output and remote.output. Returns 1.0 if identical, 0.0 otherwise. No field-level breakdown.

error_cases.name: empty_remote_output

error_data.detail: remote.output must be non-null and non-empty for exact match evaluation

preconditions: config.type == 'exact_match'
local.output is a non-empty string
remote.output is a non-empty string
postconditions: result.evaluator_type == 'exact_match'
result.score is exactly 0.0 or exactly 1.0
result.score == 1.0 if and only if local.output == remote.output

functions.name: semantic_similarity_evaluate
functions.description: SemanticSimilarityEvaluator implementation of the evaluate protocol method. Encodes local.output and remote.output using a sentence-transformers model, then computes cosine similarity. The model is lazy-loaded on first invocation and cached by model_name in a module-level dict. Accepts an optional encode_fn constructor parameter for test injection.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Configuration specifying the sentence-transformers model name.

structured_side_effects.description: Stateless evaluation. Model caching is idempotent and has no observable external side effect.

invariants: All evaluator implementations are stateless: calling evaluate with the same inputs always produces the same EvaluationResult
No evaluator implementation maintains mutable state between calls (SemanticSimilarity model cache is append-only and idempotent)
EvaluationResult is a frozen Pydantic model — immutable after construction
EvaluationResult.score is always in the closed interval [0.0, 1.0]
Each value in EvaluationResult.field_scores is in the closed interval [0.0, 1.0]
EvaluationResult.evaluator_type always matches the config type discriminator used to produce it
For StructuredMatchEvaluator: score is exactly the arithmetic mean of field_scores values
For ExactMatchEvaluator: score is exactly 0.0 or 1.0 — no intermediate values
For SemanticSimilarityEvaluator: score is clamped to [0.0, 1.0] even if raw cosine similarity is negative
The evaluator registry contains no global state — it is built explicitly and passed via dependency injection
Custom evaluators are validated against the @runtime_checkable Evaluator Protocol at startup, never at evaluation time
All EvaluatorError subtypes carry a human-readable message suitable for structured logging
Config validation is strict and fails fast at startup — invalid configs never reach evaluation time
No evaluator depends on GPU, network access, or API keys at test time when encode_fn is injected
requires: TaskResponse type must be a Pydantic v2 model with at least 'output: str' and 'fields: dict[str, str]' attributes, provided by the config_and_registry component at composition-root wiring time
